title: Chopin, Chopin! (Music in Films)

title_lang.zh_hk: 蕭邦︰生命奏鳴曲 (Music in Films)

synopsis:
Paris, 1835. At twenty-five, Frédéric Chopin is the toast of Parisian salons, adored by the aristocracy and the King. Behind the glamour of nighttime escapades, he conceals an illness with wit and humor. Though time is slipping through his fingers, he refuses to slow down. He composes masterpieces while teaching to make ends meet. Admired by friends and adored by women, Chopin ultimately discovers that amidst the fleeting fame, music is the most important thing in his life.

 

．Camerimage International Film Festival - Bronze Frog
．Polish Film Awards - Best Sound, Best Costume Design, Best Makeup, Best Production Design

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
1835年的巴黎，年僅25歲的蕭邦風華正茂，以細膩浪漫的旋律征服了法國。前來拜師學藝的門生絡繹不絕，社會名流與皇室貴族的演出邀約亦接連不斷。可惜此時，蕭邦被病魔悄然纏身。深知生命流逝，他將餘下的熱情悉數傾注於音樂與愛：與小說家喬治桑那九年波折不斷的愛戀、摯愛門生的早逝，以及對波蘭的懷鄉愁思，皆成為靈感泉源，熾熱的人生經歷化為創作養份，創下音樂巔峰。本片以宏大的製作格局，重現這位天才作曲家燦爛而短暫的一生中，最扣人心弦的精彩歲月。

 

．Camerimage 國際攝影師電影節銅蛙獎
．波蘭電影獎 - 最佳音效、最佳服裝設計、最佳化妝、最佳美術指導
